brand.name: Infatuation Apparel
brand.description: Social-commerce fashion. Confident, current and aspirational.
brand.visual_style: Photorealistic social-commerce fashion; confident, sexy, current. Realistic influencer photography in believable lifestyle locations.
brand.target_customer: Adult fashion customers looking for current going-out and lifestyle outfits.
brand.content_guidelines: Adult characters only. Accurate clothing, natural proportions and realistic skin. Keep the garment clearly visible.
brand.negative_prompt: plain studio backgrounds, runway posing, distorted anatomy, inaccurate hands and legs, oversized heads, plastic skin, excessive retouching, text, fake logos, unrealistic environments
